items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: The interviewee thanks 'John' at the beginning and end of the turn, and the interviewer mentions 'Johnny' (likely John) knowing the guys in the band, but the interviewee does not describe a personal relationship with John, only acknowledging him as part of the TV show context.

ctx.x: Yeah. And then the television was the detective shows and things like that, and there were no more variety shows. The occasional special, and that’s about it. But so, yeah, thank you John, of course. He really changed my life in many ways. And of course that show lasted for twenty years.
I can recall Johnny sitting there, and looking over there, and saying your name, and he knew all the guys in the band.
